stanza: So they went years and years
Blanket girls always there through, through that and this
"There’s nothing we cannot ever fix," I said
And the stars that catch your eyes
And the moment where you are closer by my side

blanket.line: Take you home, I, I'll give you a blanket
blanket.linePrev: Give you two seconds to cry
blanket.lineNext: Your spirit can sit and watch TV by my side
